description: Header file defining the LifecycleDelegate class, which manages application lifecycle events, subscriptions, and state transitions within a plugin-based framework. It includes internal classes for handling notifications, app ID mappings, lifecycle state registry, navigation intents, and focus management.

classes.name: LifecycleDelegate
classes.description: Main class managing application lifecycle events, subscriptions, and state transitions, including internal handlers and registries.

classes.name: LifecycleNotificationHandler
classes.description: Handles notifications for app lifecycle state changes, updating internal registries and dispatching events.

classes.name: WindowManagerNotificationHandler
classes.description: Handles window focus and blur notifications, updating focus registry and dispatching focus change events.

classes.name: AppIdInstanceIdMap
classes.description: Maintains mapping between app IDs and app instance IDs with thread safety.

classes.name: LifecycleStateRegistry
classes.description: Registry storing previous and current lifecycle states for app instances, providing JSON serialization of states.

classes.name: NavigationIntentRegistry
classes.description: Stores navigation intents associated with app instances.

classes.name: FocusedAppRegistry
classes.description: Tracks which app instance currently has focus and provides focus-related event data.

classes.name: LifecycleStateInfo
classes.description: Struct holding previous and current lifecycle states for an app instance.

methods.name: HandleLifecycle1Update
methods.description: Handles lifecycle state updates for an app instance, dispatching appropriate events based on new state.

methods.name: HandleAppFocusForLifecycle1
methods.description: Handles focus event for an app instance, updating focus registry and dispatching foreground event.

methods.name: HandleAppBlurForLifecycle1
methods.description: Handles blur event for an app instance, updating focus registry and dispatching background event.

methods.name: GetLifecycleManagerStateInterface
methods.description: Queries and returns the ILifecycleManagerState interface from the shell.

methods.name: GetWindowManagerInterface
methods.description: Queries and returns the IRDKWindowManager interface from the shell.

methods.name: DispatchLastKnownIntent
methods.description: Dispatches the last known navigation intent for a given app ID.

methods.name: GetLastKnownIntent
methods.description: Retrieves the last known navigation intent for a given app ID.

methods.name: HandleLifecycleUpdate
methods.description: Updates lifecycle state registry and dispatches state change events, including last intent dispatch if active.
